newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen recovering on retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen recovering on retail buying.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to recover slowly, helped by a rise in retail buying, when the market reopens on Sunday after the weekend, brokers said.

"The market may move up slightly as we are expecting a rise in retail buying. Existing price levels should be very lucrative," said broker Sabbir Ahmed. He said investors might particularly eye pharmaceutical and cement blue chips.
The DSE all-share price index lost 2.25 points or 0.24 percent to 922.77 on turnover of 44.9 million taka on Thursday.
Friday and Saturday mark the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
